notable_absence.finding: iQ Insights has a hard technical prerequisite ('Use SELECT statements only... Generate result sets that are within the 6 MB sizing limit and contain more than 1 document') that is a query-shape/data-shape constraint, not a role, edition, UI-mode, or access-surface gate - none of the promoted gating predicates fit, and none was forced. Left unrepresented rather than mis-typed as requiresSetting.

cross_component_finding: This page is the clearest evidence that Capella iQ introduces a real, if narrow, plan-based gating axis beyond the role gating found in configure-capellaiq.json: 'iQ Insights is available on all plans for Capella operational and Capella Analytics clusters' (so no binary plan gate on availability) but the usage rate limit (3 vs 5 charts per query) differs by free vs. paid tier, reusing the same billing:free-tier-plan/billing:paid-plan concepts already minted for cloud/indexes/query-without-index.json's sequential-scan gating. This confirms gatedByBillingPlan recurs as a real Capella-native gating mechanism distinct from requiresCapellaRole (an actor-identity gate) and requiresSupportPlan (a commercial support-tier gate, e.g. auditing's Enterprise Support Plan requirement) - three genuinely different axes now evidenced across separate batches.
